name: zen_apply_categories
title: Apply category changes
description: Write category changes back to ZenMoney. ALWAYS call with dryRun:true first (the default) to preview before -> after, present that list to the user, and only call again with dryRun:false after the user explicitly confirms. tagId null clears the category.

dryRun.description: Preview only (default true). Set false to actually write.

name: zen_find_transactions
title: Find transactions
description: Flexible filtered transaction lookup (newest first). Filter by date range, account, merchant/payee/mcc, uncategorized-only, or needs-review-only.

name: zen_import_statement
title: Import bank statement
description: Import missing transactions from an Ozon-bank PDF statement into a ZenMoney account. Deduplicates against existing transactions by date + amount; credit repayments (transfers) are never created. ALWAYS call with dryRun:true first (the default) to preview the plan, present it to the user, and only call again with dryRun:false after explicit confirmation. New transactions are created without a category (run zen_review_expenses afterwards).

filePath.description: Absolute path to the PDF statement

dryRun.description: Preview only (default true). Set false to actually write.

name: zen_list_categories
title: List categories
description: The category (tag) vocabulary with hierarchy and human-readable paths. Use the ids when proposing category changes.

name: zen_merchant_history
title: Merchant history
description: Full historical category breakdown for a place (by merchant id, payee text, or mcc): how often each category was used, totals, and recent examples. Use to dig deeper when a review row is ambiguous.

name: zen_review_expenses
title: Review expenses
description: Audit expenses in a date range: returns those that are uncategorized or likely mis-categorized, each with the current category and ranked candidate categories (with confidence) inferred from history at the same place. YOU decide the final category from this evidence, then propose changes via zen_apply_categories. Run zen_sync first if the cache may be stale.

includeOk.description: Also include expenses that look fine (default false)

name: zen_sync
title: Sync cache
description: Pull the latest data from ZenMoney into the local cache. Run this before auditing if the data may be stale. full:true re-fetches the entire history.
